review_notes: Read the whole target file and the sibling SlitUniformForwardBound.lean; grepped the Loewner directory for the kernel-remainder / triangle-inequality pattern. The two other proofs in the target (inverse_uniform_bound and initialInverse_uniform_bound) reuse the helper lemma and are not duplicated. The proposed rewrite has not been compiled. I did not check whether other files depend on the current location of exterior_displacement_le_radius.

findings.excerpt:
have hb := P.forward_kernel_remainder hi h0 hH hR hp hzH hz
  have hc := P.capacity_le_radius_sq hR (fun t => (hp t).le)
findings.problem: The proof that ‖P.forward z - z‖ ≤ 3R combines forward_kernel_remainder, capacity_le_radius_sq, the identity ‖capacity/z‖ = capacity/‖z‖, and a triangle inequality through capacity/z. SlitUniformForwardBound.forward_on_two_radius repeats this in the special case ‖z‖ = 2R. It uses the same two lemma calls, the same hdiv rewrite, the same htri triangle step, and a field_simp/nlinarith computation that the target proves in general. Its hdelta : ‖P.forward z - z‖ ≤ 3*R is a special case of the target lemma. The two proofs have to be maintained separately, and the more general lemma sits in the downstream file.
findings.proposed_change: Move exterior_displacement_le_radius, with its proof unchanged, into SlitUniformForwardBound.lean above forward_on_two_radius. It needs only forward_kernel_remainder, capacity_le_radius_sq and capacity_pos, and that file already uses all three. Then shorten forward_on_two_radius to: `have hd := P.exterior_displacement_le_radius hi h0 hH hR hp hzH hz.ge; have hsum := norm_le_norm_sub_add (P.forward z) z; rw [hz] at hsum; linarith`. The hb, hc, hdiv, htri, he and hcost blocks and the field_simp step go away. SlitUniformInverseBound.lean still sees the lemma through its import of SlitUniformForwardBound, so inverse_uniform_bound is unchanged.
findings.benefit: The kernel-remainder and capacity-quotient estimate is proved once, for all ‖z‖ ≥ 2R. forward_on_two_radius becomes a short consequence, and any change to the constants (such as the 10·cap·R/‖z‖² term) is made in one place.
